svg.title: The same code, as vectors or boxed
svg.desc: On the Xeon 8573C on 21 November 2026, on common data, exp's finish row reads 0.008 bytes per 1024 doubles at 256 bits, and 528,384 bytes at 128 bits on x86, where the masks box.
